steps.note: Start a buyer-side eRFX event because the case concerns an RFQ.
Enable the setting whose bid-submission behavior is under test.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply an available RFQ template before adding line items.
Confirm that the RFQ stage has a template applied.
Create multiple line items so a subset bid could be distinguished from a full bid.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite a vendor whose bid behavior can be inspected.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can access its bid sheet.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the RFQ pricing round where partial bidding would need to be performed.
Confirm the vendor bid submission control is available; the catalog cannot use it to submit only selected line items.
